title: Devobs prioritized implementation backlog
constraints: No task may merge, deploy, spend, activate paid inference or modify main.
One task per feature branch and isolated worktree; Draft PR only.
Keep CI, CodeQL, Trivy, PostgreSQL RLS and Phase 8 human approval gates intact.
No secrets, tokens, private logs or hosted environment values in code or reports.
Do not duplicate merged work (devobs/ai_quality_gate, devobs/integration_control) or the unmerged provider evaluation branch.

tasks.objective: Obtain and record the owner's preserve-or-retire decision for the expiring Render Free PostgreSQL database without performing any provider action.
dependencies: Owner decision naming exact resource ID, action and UTC window before 2026-12-05T10:33:24Z.
tasks.implementation_approach: Add an appendix with the signed decision, exact resource ID dpg-dbm5msu1egvs73be46og-a, chosen action, UTC window and evidence links. No dashboard, API or Blueprint change; do not re-import render.yaml.
acceptance_criteria: Decision appendix is owner-signed and scoped to one action and date.
Offline expiry guard still exits 1 until the decision is executed under separate approval.
No provider API call, data export or deletion recorded.
tasks.risk_and_rollback: Irreversible data loss if misread as execute permission; rollback by reverting the appendix on the feature branch. Keep the database unchanged.
tasks.draft_pr_instructions: Draft PR to main, label advisory, include the guard output and state explicitly that no provider action was taken; no merge.

tasks.objective: Produce enforceable combined USD spend-cap evidence and add token/usage accounting fields to advisory provider results without enabling paid calls.
dependencies: Owner finance decision and provider-side configuration access.
tasks.implementation_approach: Capture provider usage fields where available as ESTIMATED/UNKNOWN, add a bounded local ledger, and document that a boolean approval flag is not a dollar cap. Keep DEVOBS_AI_BUDGET_APPROVED false.
acceptance_criteria: No live provider call occurs in tests.
Cost status is never reported as verified without evidence.
P01 SPEND control remains BLOCKED until provider-side cap evidence is recorded.
tasks.risk_and_rollback: Misinterpreting estimates as bills; revert feature commits. No spend authorization is created by this task.
tasks.draft_pr_instructions: Draft PR with before/after schema excerpt and exact test outputs; no merge.

tasks.objective: Collect the seven AI-9 acceptance controls with exact SHA, reviewer and HTTPS evidence links while keeping the gate BLOCKED until independently reviewed.
dependencies: Independent evaluation corpus owner and reviewer assignment.
tasks.implementation_approach: Append evidence objects only after verification; never auto-promote. Preserve fail-closed freshness and HTTPS checks.
acceptance_criteria: Each control has source_sha, reviewer, observed_at and evidence_url or stays UNVERIFIED.
check_ai9_evidence.py never returns GO without signed evidence.
Gate remains BLOCKED in the ledger until owner review.
tasks.risk_and_rollback: False GO claim; revert evidence edits. No detector activation.
tasks.draft_pr_instructions: Draft PR with sanitized evidence list and explicit NO-GO statement; no merge.

tasks.objective: Add a documented, owner-approved procedure and offline harness for hosted negative-tenant and OIDC acceptance without performing it in CI by default.
dependencies: Owner staging approval and redacted evidence channel.
tasks.implementation_approach: Add an opt-in, explicitly authorized test path with fail-closed defaults; no credentials in source; redact all evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Default CI path performs no hosted call.
Negative-tenant denial is proven only with redacted exact-SHA evidence.
P01 OIDC/RLS controls remain BLOCKED until owner review.
tasks.risk_and_rollback: Credential exposure or false acceptance; revert path; never log tokens.
tasks.draft_pr_instructions: Draft PR with offline test output and procedure; no merge, no hosted run in CI.

tasks.objective: Fix the V-01 review-count weakness and implement runtime wheel-hash verification (F04) without weakening existing gates.
dependencies: Owner review of security review findings V-01 and F04.
tasks.implementation_approach: Fail closed when required approvals are absent; verify wheel hashes explicitly rather than relying on version strings; keep permissions minimal and actions pinned.
acceptance_criteria: Writer-only merge path is rejected in the policy checker.
Wrong wheel with correct version is rejected.
Existing action pin and agent spec checks stay green.
tasks.risk_and_rollback: False negatives block CI; revert commits; never disable the underlying check.
tasks.draft_pr_instructions: Draft PR with adversarial test cases and before/after outputs; no merge.

tasks.objective: Re-test remaining medium multi-agent audit findings at the audited SHA and add regressions; AUD-02 is already fixed in 37475b0 (#732).
tasks.implementation_approach: Add adversarial fixtures for self-asserted evidence, disabled-agent ownership, branch/PR validation; keep blocked tasks blocking ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Each reproduced finding has a failing-then-passing regression test.
AUD-02 fix commit 37475b0 is confirmed as ancestor of the PR head.
No agent runtime is started by tests.
tasks.risk_and_rollback: Over-tightening blocks valid work; revert specific regression and document exception.
tasks.draft_pr_instructions: Draft PR with the adversarial test list and exact outputs; no merge.

tasks.objective: Decide whether to merge the already-built offline provider evaluation harness from feature/ai-provider-evaluation-finalization rather than rebuilding it.
dependencies: Owner review of that branch's 5 commits ending at 7dff0c0; zero open PRs at audit time.
tasks.implementation_approach: No code change in this audit. If approved, open a Draft PR from the existing branch, preserve its 16 tests and UNKNOWN pricing rule.
acceptance_criteria: No duplicate harness is created on main.
Harness remains offline and never calls a paid API.
Owner decision recorded in the PR description.
tasks.risk_and_rollback: Duplicate ownership conflict; close the Draft PR and keep main untouched.
tasks.draft_pr_instructions: Draft PR only after owner decision; no merge.

dependencies: Legal/tax review and processor selection decision.
tasks.implementation_approach: Document processor, webhook signature validation, idempotency, plan quotas, reconciliation, refunds, export/delete and retention; no credentials or live processor calls.
acceptance_criteria: Design distinguishes DOCUMENTED from IMPLEMENTED for every control.
No customer signup is enabled by this task.
Commercial gate remains BLOCKED.
tasks.risk_and_rollback: None to production; revert docs if rejected.
tasks.draft_pr_instructions: Draft PR with design and legal-question list; no merge.

dependencies: Owner SLO targets and decision on external receiver.
tasks.implementation_approach: Add offline fixture-driven alert tests and documented SLO definitions; no hosted metrics endpoint or external receiver in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Alerts remain loopback-only by default.
No secret-bearing mount is opened or printed.
SLO claims remain UNVERIFIED until hosted metrics exist.
tasks.risk_and_rollback: None to production; revert manifest changes if rejected.
tasks.draft_pr_instructions: Draft PR with sanitized dashboard snapshot; no merge.
